wars.name: Mongol invasion of Champa
wars.outcome: Sogetu's fleet landed near Thị Nại Bay in February 1283 and took Vijaya two days later; the Mongols held it until they were repelled in June 1285 and Sogetu was killed at Chương Dương. Champa later became a tributary state. No land was kept.
wars.note: The 1282 start is the page's preparation of the fleet; the first fighting was in February 1283. New in the repair round ia-02-a. Mirrors champa ledger/29-30.

wars.name: Mongol invasions of Đại Việt

zones.text: Thăng Long, occupied February to June 1285 and February to March 1288

wars.outcome: The Yuan took Thăng Long in February 1285 and left on 9 June 1285, returned in February 1288 and retreated to Vạn Kiếp on 5 March 1288; their fleet was ambushed at the Bạch Đằng River in April 1288. No land was kept; Đại Việt and Champa 'decided to accept the nominal supremacy of the Yuan dynasty and became tributary states'. The Mongol Empire page: 'tried to invade Đại Việt again in 1285 and 1287 but were defeated both times'.
wars.note: Repair round ia-02-a: zone and end year (1288) added; occupation pairs in the ledger mirror ngo-dynasty ledger/21-26. The earlier source was the Mongol Empire page.
